description: Users are unable to access company VPN since morning. Around 25 employees are affected.
A user cannot log in because the password reset link is not working.
Corporate email is unavailable for several employees.
Production database connections are failing and the application is returning errors.
One employee reports slow Wi-Fi connectivity.
An application API is returning 500 errors after a deployment.
A user requests installation of an approved analytics application.
Users receive access denied errors for a shared application.
Production server CPU is continuously above 90 percent.
The entire department cannot access an internal service.
